headline: Shavkat Mirziyoyev to make a state visit to Oman on November 16–17
summary: Uzbekistan's president Shavkat Mirziyoyev will make a state visit to Oman on November 16-17 at the sultan's invitation. Agenda items include expanding trade, investment and agricultural cooperation.
why: Bilateral state visits often produce trade and investment agreements that can open new export and project opportunities for both economies.
original_headline: Shavkat Mirziyoyev 16−17-noyabr kunlari davlat tashrifi bilan O‘monda bo‘ladi
